verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail advertises a direct API and Zapier integration for automating mailbox workflows, which could in principle be scripted/run in CI, but there is no documentation of CLI usage, headless operation, authentication tokens for service accounts, or CI-specific guidance. Probes also show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs (404s), undermining confidence that the API is well-suited for automated/headless integration. missing for 10: CLI or SDK for automation, explicit CI/headless usage docs, discoverable OpenAPI/API reference.
